ns2:course.label: Sound Design I
ns2:course.description: Introduction to concepts of theatrical sound design and basic sound system design as applied to the modern theatre. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Graduate students do an additional in-depth audio mixing project and an additional sound effects creative project. Prerequisite: Thea 351 Introduction to Digital Audio Workstations and THEA 453 Introduction to Theatre Sound.
